items.text: Senior Security Engineer with 6+ years of experience across cloud security, detection engineering, DFIR, and application security in regulated fintech and health-tech environments.

entries.heading: Senior Security Engineer | IronVault Payments | 2021 – Present

items.text: Technical lead for cloud security and detection engineering across a PCI-DSS Level 1 and SOC 2 Type II regulated payment processing platform handling $14B in annual volume.

Hardened a 70-account AWS Organization by enforcing Service Control Policies (SCPs), eliminating 1,400+ wildcard IAM policies via IAM Access Analyzer, and rolling out ephemeral just-in-time role elevation.

Conducted 60+ STRIDE threat modeling workshops and security architecture reviews with product engineering squads prior to launch, uncovering 23 high-severity broken-access-control and SSRF flaws pre-code.

Authored version-controlled behavioral alert queries in Python and SQL over centralized CloudTrail, Okta, and EDR telemetry tables, cutting false-positive pager volume by 64% while catching anomalous token minting within 90 seconds.

Served as primary Incident Commander on 14 sev-1 DFIR engagements—isolating compromised EC2 workloads, capturing volatile memory and EBS snapshots, rotating leaked OAuth secrets, and driving corrective action tracking.
Locked down multi-tenant EKS and k8s clusters using Kyverno admission webhooks, default-deny Calico CNI rules, distroless container base images, and Falco eBPF kernel-event sensors.
Presented quarterly board-level risk heatmaps and ROI models that secured $480k in headcount and tooling budget to retire legacy VPN concentrators in favor of BeyondCorp zero-trust access.
Built automated Terraform Sentinel policy-as-code guardrails that block public S3 buckets, unencrypted RDS instances, and permissive security groups at plan time.

entries.heading: Application Security Engineer | Veridian Care Systems | 2018 – 2021

items.text: Owned application security for a HIPAA-regulated telehealth platform serving 1.8M patients across web, iOS, and microservices.

Wired Semgrep custom AST checks, OWASP ZAP dynamic scans, TruffleHog pre-commit hooks, and automated dependency vulnerability gates into GitHub pull requests across 190 repositories, blocking 310 leaked credentials and critical CVEs before merge.

Triaged 180+ vulnerability disclosures from external security researchers, validated proof-of-concept exploits, managed bounty payouts, and coordinated 7-day SLA remediation sprints with feature squads.
Designed and rolled out a Security Champions program across 12 product squads, training 25 engineers on IDOR prevention, parameterized queries, and CSRF defenses.
Migrated workforce authentication to Okta with phishing-resistant WebAuthn factors and automated SCIM deprovisioning tied to HR termination webhooks.
Performed manual source-code audits and Burp Suite Pro assessments on OAuth 2.0 / OIDC patient portal flows.
Organized internal Capture-the-Flag (CTF) cryptography puzzles on Caesar and Vigenère ciphers for annual Security Awareness Month.
Automated SOC 2 and HIPAA evidence collection using Python scripts querying AWS Config and GitHub branch-protection APIs, cutting audit prep time by 70%.
Enforced YubiKey FIDO2 hardware security keys for privileged production bastion and SSO logins across all 340 employees.
Wrote a Go CLI that correlates 90 days of AWS CloudTrail action logs against attached IAM role policies to generate least-privilege Terraform diffs (520+ GitHub stars).
Added support for cross-account AssumeRole chain visualization and unused access-key expiration alerts.
Applied Six Sigma process metrics and Jira automation rules to cut third-party vendor security questionnaire turnaround times from 18 days to 5 days.

entries.heading: B.S. in Information Security & Computer Science | University of Maryland, College Park | 2018

AppSec & SecOps: STRIDE Threat Modeling, Semgrep, Burp Suite Pro, OWASP ZAP, TruffleHog, DFIR, OSQuery, CrowdStrike
